name: MERSEC
recent: Mercury Securities Group Berhad 近期公告主要涉及地址变更和首席人员变动，并发布了截至2026年7月31日的季度业绩。公司没有重大合约或企业活动公告。
notable: 公司秘书/主要人员变更：Miss Chan Tze Xin 于2026年9月2日辞任主要人员职务。
公司注册地址发生变更，分别于2026年9月9日和2026年11月17日公告。
earnings: 截至2026年7月31日的季度，公司营收为8,891,973令吉，环比下降10.2%，但同比增长35.3%；净利为4,227,514令吉，环比增长11.1%，同比增长33.4%；净利率为47.5%，高于上一季度的38.4%。

recent_en: Mercury Securities Group Berhad's recent announcements mainly involve changes of address and a change in principal officer, along with the release of quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026. There were no major contract or corporate activity announcements.
notable_en: Change in principal officer: Miss Chan Tze Xin ceased to be a principal officer on 2 September 2026.
Change of registered address announced on 9 September 2026 and 17 November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 8,891,973, down 10.2% QoQ but up 35.3% YoY; net income was MYR 4,227,514, up 11.1% QoQ and 33.4% YoY; net margin was 47.5%, higher than 38.4% in the previous quarter.
